variations.entry_rules: Identify Fair Value Gap (FVG) on 1m. Wait for price to return to FVG 50% level. Enter on rejection with Stop Loss below/above FVG. Volume must confirm (above average on rejection candle).
variations.exit_rules: Take profit at next liquidity pool (previous swing high/low) or 2:1 R/R minimum. Trail stop at 50% once 1:1 reached. Max hold 10 minutes.
variations.changed_from_base: Reduced to 1m timeframe, tightened hold time, smaller FVG requirements
variations.notes: Very active scalping. Requires excellent chart reading skills.

variations.name: ICT SMC - 5m Standard
variations.entry_rules: Identify Fair Value Gap (FVG) on 5m. Wait for price to return to FVG 50% level. Enter on rejection with Stop Loss below/above FVG. Volume must confirm (above average on rejection candle).
